assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness, raising concern for potential arrhythmias in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and assess for any hemodynamic instability related to valvular disease.
The CPT code for the service is 93226.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-16.
